title: EpicNeeds
description: A Best plugin with homes, warps, and AFK.
body:
# 🔧 EpicNeeds – The Ultimate Plugin

EpicNeeds is a lightweight, all-in-one Minecraft plugin designed to replace EssentialsX with improved performance and YAML-based data storage. It offers powerful core features like homes, warps, spawn, TPA system, private messaging, nickname system, AFK detection, gamemode controls, weather/time commands, fly/god modes, and more — all with colorful messages and user-friendly permissions.

✅ No database needed
✅ YAML file storage
✅ Plugin prefix support ([EpicNeeds])
✅ Fully permission-based
✅ Simple, intuitive commands
✅ Lightweight for low-lag servers
